name: Bonares (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bonares (grapes and a tree on green).
history: Municipal flag of Bonares; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Bonares arms — grapes and tree on green
